summary: Added monai/utils/jupyter_utils.py with ThreadContainer (background thread with cooperative stop, result and exception capture), StopButton, and ThreadButton (ipywidgets helpers, lazily imported). Added tests/test_jupyter_utils.py: 4 non-widget tests pass; 2 widget tests skipped because ipywidgets is not installed in the shared venv, so widget code is unverified. Added a Jupyter section to docs/source/utils.rst. Nothing committed. Lint tools (flake8, black) are not in the venv, so linting was not run; line length was checked manually. The full quick test suite was not run.
